author: Swinhoe, 1863
status: 나그네새 수만 마리 · 여름철새 수천 마리
summary: 관목림과 낙엽활엽수림에 살며, 여름에 우리나라 전역에서 흔히 번식하는 여름철새이다. 홀로 또는 암수가 함께 지낸다. 땅 위에 둥지를 틀고 5~7월에 한배에 5~7개의 알을 낳는다. 딱정벌레목, 매미목, 메뚜기목, 파리목, 벌목 따위의 곤충을 주로 먹고 다족류도 먹으며, 중국 남부, 타이완, 하이난섬, 인도네시아, 미얀마 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: dark brown crown with darker feather edges

art.subject: Asian Stubtail (Urosphena squameiceps), adult (sexes alike), as seen on the floor of Korean deciduous forest from May to August: crown dark brown with darker scaly feather edges; long, prominent creamy-buff supercilium from the bill to the nape; broad dark brown eye-stripe below it; cheeks and ear coverts cream-buff, faintly scaled darker; upperparts warm brown; tiny tail plain brown; chin and throat pale buff, breast tinged brownish, belly centre clean glossy white, flanks olive-brown with buff belly sides. Bill thin: upper mandible brown, lower mandible pale apricot-buff at the base. Dark brown eye. Long pale pinkish-white legs.
art.pose: standing on the forest floor beneath shrubs, side view
art.scene: Korean summer deciduous broadleaf forest with shrubby undergrowth; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing on leaf litter: long creamy-buff supercilium, broad dark eye-stripe, scaly dark brown crown, cream-buff face, brown back, almost no tail, white belly centre, olive-brown flanks, long pale pinkish legs
adult, head detail in profile: prominent pale supercilium above a dark eye-stripe, scaly crown, brown upper mandible and pale apricot-based lower mandible
art.build: Tiny, round-bodied, almost tail-less warbler, about 9cm, much smaller than a sparrow; large head with a long pale supercilium. Bill short, fine and pointed. Legs long for its size, pale pinkish-white, giving a perky stance. Tail extremely short, barely projecting beyond the wingtips and undertail coverts. Wings short and rounded. Creeps and hops on the forest floor and in low tangles like a mouse, often flicking its tiny tail.
avoid: Do not paint a normal-length or cocked tail; the tail is a tiny stub (Eurasian Wren cocks a longer, barred tail).
Do not paint barring on the wings, tail or flanks (Eurasian Wren).
Do not paint dark or short legs; they are long and pale pinkish.
Do not paint yellow or green tones; the plumage is brown, buff and white.
